experiment_name: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II)
fuel_materials: PMMA rods, flat slabs, cotton-fiberglass fabrics
scientific_scope: Flame spread rates, extinction limits, concurrent/opposed flow, and minimum oxygen concentration for solid materials in microgravity.
rag_responsibility: Supplies research evidence passages, extinction mechanisms, quenching flow velocities, and peer-reviewed citations (NTRS 20210011385, NTRS 20160000593).
data_module_responsibility: Supplies sensor telemetry, thermocouple curves, video flame spread rates (mm/s), and mass burning measurements.

fuel_materials: 4-sample card (PMMA, Nomex, cotton blends, SIBAL fabric)
scientific_scope: Realistic spacecraft fire growth, sample interactions, heat release, toxic gas release (CO, CO2, HCN, HCl), and elevated oxygen conditions (up to 26% O2).
rag_responsibility: Supplies large-scale fire spread context, sample layout findings, toxic gas evolution theory, and citations (ICES-2024-365, NTRS 20240002981).
data_module_responsibility: Supplies calibrated radiometer heat flux (kW/m2), mass loss rate, pressure transducer logs, and FTIR gas spectrometer concentrations (ppm).

fuel_materials: Overheated wire insulation (Teflon, Kapton), pyrolysis particulate
scientific_scope: Smoke particle agglomeration, particle size distribution, and optical detector response in microgravity.
rag_responsibility: Supplies agglomeration physics, MOM/DMA instrumentation principles, spacecraft smoke detection theory, and citations (NIST Pub 904707).
data_module_responsibility: Supplies particle diameter distributions, optical density measurements, and laser transmission percentages.

scientific_scope: Soot inception, smoke point scaling, and radiative emissions from laminar co-flow diffusion flames without buoyant acceleration.
rag_responsibility: Supplies soot formation physics, smoke point mechanisms, non-buoyant flow scaling, and citations (PSI-107 Fact Sheet).
data_module_responsibility: Supplies burner fuel exit velocity (cm/s), soot volume fraction profiles, and flame height measurements.

experiment_name: Structure and Liftoff in Combustion Experiment (SLICE)
fuel_materials: Diluted methane and ethylene jet flames
scientific_scope: Flame lift-off, stabilization mechanisms, blowout limits, and chemical kinetics in non-buoyant flows.
rag_responsibility: Supplies flame liftoff theory, non-buoyant flame stabilization mechanisms, and citations (PSI-106 Fact Sheet).
data_module_responsibility: Supplies liftoff height (mm), co-flow velocity ratios, and blowout velocity limits.

investigation: Gas-Phase Diffusion Flame Extinction & Soot Diagnostics
scientific_scope: Spherical diffusion flame extinction, cool flames, and soot suppression under varying diluent and oxygen regimes.
rag_responsibility: Supplies ACME modular architecture descriptions, burner principles, and published literature context.
data_module_responsibility: Supplies fuel mass flow rates, spectral emission intensities, and chamber oxygen percentages.

facility: ISS CIR Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA)
scientific_scope: Isolated spherical droplet burning, d-squared law behavior, radiative extinction, and cool flame secondary burning in microgravity.
rag_responsibility: Supplies droplet burning physics, extinction boundary theories, and suppressant comparison context.
data_module_responsibility: Supplies droplet diameter vs time curves (d2/t), burning rate constants (k), and extinction diameter values.

fuel_materials: Nylon, Velcro, wiring insulation in 100% pure oxygen at 16.7 psia
scientific_scope: High-pressure pure oxygen flammability hazards, explosive flame propagation, toxic gas generation, and cabin pressure rupture.
rag_responsibility: Supplies official Apollo 204 Review Board findings, ignition hazard analysis, and historical fire safety lessons (NASA-TM-84105).
data_module_responsibility: Supplies historical pressure transducer records, time-to-rupture data, and cabin atmosphere logs.

facility: Apollo Service Module Cryogenic Oxygen Tank 2
fuel_materials: Teflon wire insulation, aluminum conduit in high-pressure pure oxygen
scientific_scope: Combustion in supercritical oxygen tanks, electrical arcing ignition, thermostatic heater switch failure, and structural pressure vessel rupture.
rag_responsibility: Supplies Edgar Cortright Review Board findings, thermal-electrical design deficiencies, and high-pressure oxygen combustion context.
data_module_responsibility: Supplies cryogenic tank pressure telemetry, temperature sensor readouts, and tank quantity sensor data.

investigation: Orbital Station Cabin Fire & Toxic Atmosphere Response
fuel_materials: Solid Fuel Oxygen Generator (SFOG / Vika candle)
scientific_scope: Torch-like open fire in microgravity, smoke dispersion in closed cabin environments, extinguisher efficacy, and crew protective breathing gear.
rag_responsibility: Supplies official Russian/NASA investigation summaries, microgravity smoke handling procedures, and fire suppression lessons.
data_module_responsibility: Supplies cabin atmospheric sensor logs, toxic CO/smoke aerosol concentrations, and emergency timeline logs.
